series_rules: Use Honey Bear and Bootsie Belle as the central characters unless explicitly directed otherwise.
Do not invent replacement main pets such as Tiny, Mr. Whiskers, Miss Peaches, or generic unnamed Yorkies/cats.
The story should feel like visual comic comedy, not a pleasant greeting card scene.
Each idea must be easy to turn into four 1:1 comic panels.
Keep dialogue short enough for readable comic bubbles.
Avoid repeating obvious recent topics, titles, punchlines, locations, and props.
Bootsie Belle should often deliver the final witty line, unless Honey Bear's panic creates a stronger punchline.
Use Southern flavor without making every story about sweet tea.
Prefer one clear gag per story.

panel_structure.1: Setup: establish location, problem, or temptation.
panel_structure.2: Escalation: Honey Bear overreacts or Bootsie notices the flaw.
panel_structure.3: Complication: the situation becomes visually absurd.
panel_structure.4: Punchline: clean visual payoff and witty final line.

dialogue_rules: One or two short speech bubbles per panel is preferred.
Make speech bubble text image-generator friendly.
banned_patterns: Do not title multiple stories the same thing.
Do not generate another Sweet Tea Showdown unless directly requested.
Do not introduce generic side pets in place of Honey Bear and Bootsie Belle.
Do not make every panel characters sitting and chatting.
